address: Trip Lane, Linton, Wetherby, West Yorkshire ,LS22 4JA
bio: Escape the every day to this charming West Yorkshire estate, Wood Hall Hotel & Spa for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Nestled within picturesque gardens, the hotel’s striking architecture and impressive interiors create the perfect backdrop to indulge in Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea at Wood Hall Hotel & Spa is served in the Georgian Restaurant, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  Enjoy the age-old tradition of a traditional Afternoon Tea with  an array of savoury treats, scones, and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. They also refresh our menu regularly to celebrate various occasions and celebrations throughout the year.  They pride themselves on catering for a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan, and special children's Afternoon Tea options. As the crowning touch, upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury.
